paper.title_en: Relativistic Navier-Stokes description of the quark-gluon plasma radial flow
paper.abstract_en: Using relativistic Navier-Stokes in the well-posed Bemfica-Disconzi-Noronha-Kovtun (BDNK) formulation, with a QCD equation of state and transport coefficients, we perform simulations that describe the radial flow in central Pb-Pb collisions measured at the LHC, providing a proof of principle for its viability in heavy-ion phenomenology. We identify causal frames that retain the Landau-frame interpretation, and verify frame robustness. Müller-Israel-Stewart simulations with identical input show large second-order effects, exceeding the frame dependence of relativistic Navier-Stokes, as well as causality violations.
